issue: Declared local law can derive useful collective complement information without generic physical acquisition
clarification: N801 derives source weights,collective slow mode and an all-omitted-mode complement bound from exact configuration weights under the supplied pairwise-cycle/Glauber class. It narrows a fixed-response global-gap ablation and preserves all source outside the represented defect neighborhood. New query engineering reduces the incoming implementation calls but prior additive methods are stronger asymptotically. Exact unseen-well and mobility countermodels preserve the model-validation boundary. No contradiction of N793 or general physical gate discovery is asserted.
